personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT (with user custom oat sand palette & sharp structural edges)
personality_one_liner: A rigorous, broadsheet-inspired fact-checking and news analysis instrument pairing typographic clarity with stark structural separation.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room, clean structural margins, 0px border radius (sharp structural edges) per user choice.

do's: Use sharp 1pt solid borders for all containers
Strict separation of ML prediction track and External evidence review track
Keep text high contrast against oat sand surface
dont's: No combined verdict between ML and Evidence

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Supabase email/password authentication screen for registration and sign-in prior to analysis.

states.empty: Clean form fields with terracotta primary action

screens.layout: Centered editorial card layout with bold Nunito headers, sharp border framing, clear input labels, and sticky submit action.

screens.name: Home / Analysis
screens.purpose: Core claim, text, and URL input interface submitting to Flask backend for TF-IDF + Logistic Regression and multi-provider evidence.

states.loading: Analyzing text and querying fact-check providers...
states.empty: Enter a news claim, paste article text, or input URL to initiate verification.
states.error: Failed to connect to verification API. Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical stacked editor with tab toggle (Text / URL), clear submit button, followed by visually separate ML Prediction Track and External Evidence Track with zero combined verdict.

screens.name: Discovery
screens.purpose: Worldwide multi-provider news and fact-check discovery feed with curated primary sources.

states.error: Unable to fetch global feed. Retry.

screens.layout: Brothersheet list with filter chips, source metadata badges, and direct drill-down to detail view.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: User-specific analysis history protected by PostgreSQL RLS with minimal retention and clear/delete options.
screens.layout: Chronological list of past analyses with timestamps, claim snippets, and quick delete action.

screens.name: Notifications & Sources
screens.purpose: In-app notifications and curated primary sources directory with health status.

states.empty: All caught up. No new notifications.

screens.layout: Divided sections for system alerts and active fact-check providers with status indicators.

screens.name: Settings & Legal
screens.purpose: Account info, data retention details, Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and sign out.
screens.layout: Clean editorial list linking to legal documents (TOS & Privacy Policy) and sign out action.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly implement user choices: Nunito typography, oat sand background (#FDFBF7), deep charcoal text (#2C2A29), terracotta (#C87965) and muted olive (#7D846C) accents. Sharp structural edges (0 radius), no shadows, no gradients, no emojis anywhere. Visually separate ML prediction track and external evidence review track with NO combined verdict anywhere. Supabase auth required before analysis. Flask JSON API with TF-IDF + Logistic Regression baseline and Groq explanation.
